description: Deployment binding for the opt-in learned 3D-Fixer observed-context completion provider on SeetaCloud. Use only through scripts/three_d_fixer_cli.py, which replaces geometry_completion with observed_context_completion in that process's registry. This provider consumes original observed RGB, verified masks, calibrated cameras and observed depth; it has no generated-orbit dependency. PYTHONPATH adds external/three-d-fixer-shims, a faithful minimal kaolin.utils.testing.check_tensor shim required only by the vendored FlexiCubes debug assertions; the audited 3D-Fixer source files are untouched. Add --prepare-only to audit inputs without model inference (never publishes roles).
